source.name: QIIB press release: QIIB Signs Sponsorship Agreement with Al-Gharafa SC for the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 Football Seasons
source.quote: Under the agreement, QIIB will be the club's official sponsor for the 2025–2026 and 2026–2027 football seasons.

note: Deal signed 6 Jan 2026, covering the 2025-26 and 2026-27 seasons; no value reported.
